_: The website carries a copy as data/cookbook.json and refuses to build
when its copy hashes to something other than `digest` below.

recipes.title: Extract the text of a document
recipes.intent: Open a document and print its text, first as one string in reading order and then page by page.

recipes.title: Render every page to PNG
recipes.intent: Rasterise each page to a PNG at a chosen resolution; to_images writes the files and returns their paths.

recipes.title: Read text with its position, then merge two documents
recipes.intent: Walk each text block with its bounding box, then combine two documents into a single output.

recipes.title: Work on a PDF that headless Chrome produced
recipes.intent: Watermark, compress and archive an exported document; PDFluent does not convert HTML itself.

recipes.title: Read an XFA form and write one field
recipes.intent: List the logical fields of an XFA form and set one of them by its SOM path.

recipes.title: Fill an XFA form and save it
recipes.intent: Set a field, confirm it reached the datasets packet, and save the filled document.

recipes.title: Check a document against PDF/A-2b
recipes.intent: Run the PDF/A-2b check and print every violation it reports.

recipes.title: Check first, then convert to PDF/A
recipes.intent: Read the findings before converting; convert_to_pdfa hands back a new document instead of changing this one.

recipes.title: Sign with a PKCS#12 certificate
recipes.intent: Sign a document from a .p12 file, choosing the PAdES profile this build can honour.

recipes.title: Verify the signatures on a document
recipes.intent: Walk the validations of a signed document and handle each status, including ones this build does not know.
